user_question: My order says delivered, but I never received it. What should I do?
ai_customer_facing_answer: If your DoorDash order did not arrive, you can report it through your DoorDash account. In the DoorDash app, go to Orders, select the relevant order, tap Help, choose Delivery Issues, then select "Order never arrived," and follow the prompts to either select a resolution or chat with an agent. On the desktop site, open Orders, choose the order, select Help, then under "Delivery issues" select "Order never arrived" and follow the same prompts. DoorDash says it investigates orders reported as never delivered. The public help article does not state whether a refund, credit, or redelivery is guaranteed, so the final outcome may depend on DoorDash's review of your specific order. You can also use live chat in the DoorDash app or call 855-431-0459 for live support.

user_question: My driver never arrived, but I was still charged. Can I get a refund?
ai_customer_facing_answer: Whether you can get a refund depends on what kind of charge you received, so the first step is identifying the charge type. If you were charged for a trip you did not take, Uber has a specific flow — open Uber's "I would like to get a refund on the trip I didn't take" help page, select the trip date or use the toggle to indicate you didn't take it, log in, and submit. If the charge is a cancellation fee, Uber says a cancellation fee will not apply if Uber detects your driver did not make progress to your pickup location, or if your driver was 5 or more minutes late; if you believe the cancellation fee was incorrect, enter the trip date in the cancellation-fee review form. If the amount looks like a full fare on a canceled trip, Uber says it may actually be a temporary authorization hold — Uber voids the hold immediately, but it can take a few business days to clear depending on your bank. The public articles do not guarantee a refund; Uber will get back to you after reviewing the specific trip.

user_question: I canceled because the driver was not moving. Why was I charged a cancellation fee?
ai_customer_facing_answer: Lyft may charge a cancellation fee in any of these situations: you cancel more than 30 seconds after a driver accepts your ride, more than 30 seconds after requesting a Wait and Save ride, after your driver arrives, or after 3 or more rides within a 15-minute timeframe. If the charge is showing as pending rather than final, Lyft says it may be a temporary authorization that will either disappear or show as a refund within 5–7 business days once your bank processes it. If you believe the cancellation fee was wrong — for example, because the driver did not appear to be moving toward you — you can dispute it in the Lyft app: open your profile, go to Account > Ride history, select the ride, and choose Dispute ride charge. The public rider article does not state that a stationary or non-progressing driver automatically makes you eligible for a refund, so the right next step is to file the dispute and let Lyft review the ride.

user_question: My groceries are missing several items. Can I get a refund?
ai_customer_facing_answer: You may be eligible for a refund or credit for missing grocery items, but it is subject to Instacart's conditions. You can self-report missing items within 3 days of pickup or delivery (restaurant orders excluded), and you should report each issue separately. In the app, tap the Account icon, go to Orders, tap Get help on the relevant order, choose the issue, select the affected items, and choose your preferred resolution. On the website, open Your orders, click Report a problem on the relevant order, select the issue and the affected items, and choose a resolution. For missing or damaged items, Instacart may issue a refund or credit up to the amount you paid; partial refunds or credits may apply if only part of an item is missing or damaged. If you report within 24 hours of receiving the order, a same-day refund may apply, shown as an adjustment to the original charge. A few payment types are handled separately, EBT SNAP orders are refund-only and handled by Instacart Customer Experience, and PayPal or Klarna refunds are returned to those accounts.
